helper_proposals.title: Optional box-owned OSC handler registration
helper_proposals.rationale: Cached servers and clients are useful across edits, but global address slots retain callbacks from retired boxes. Repeated receiving examples must explain manual removal/reset because no opt-in box ownership wrapper exists in osc.kt.
helper_proposals.after: Illustrative API: oscOn(port, address) { message -> /* main-thread work */ }; registration belongs to the box run, with an explicit persistent option for shared service code.

evidence.detail: OscServers cache by port; on replaces a pattern slot but returns Unit; remove removes by pattern, without registration identity.

Reuse RunScope policy machinery; preserve the documented global server API.
